Philippines: Typhoon Uwan (Fung-wong) is forecasted to bring strong winds and heavy rainfall to several regions in the coming days. Current projections show the storm hitting central or northern Luzon by early morning Nov. 10 as a level five typhoon with winds exceeding 115 mph.  
This is a life-threatening storm.  
High winds may damage structures and cause widespread electrical outages - leaving some areas without electricity or basic services.  U.S. citizens should follow local guidance, including evacuation orders.  Those who choose to remain in the storm’s path should prepare for life-threatening winds and flooding and stockpile food, water, and medication.
